summary: Two web tests stop depending on how fast a host runs. The replay browser e2e no longer gives its wait for the conversation pane's module a 10-second limit that ran from the page load through every replay step; the script's own 90-second deadline is the one bound. The scroll viewport story drives the eased return from a clock it controls and checks that half of the 200ms is on the way and the full 200ms is the end. Test-only change.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no replay or stored data changes.

compatibility.detail: No runtime compatibility change; the components are unchanged.

recovery.detail: No persisted state or recovery change.
